name: Delegated Short-lived Agent Identity
mechanism: Uses a stable auditable agent identity plus task-scoped short-lived credentials that preserve the invoking user and delegated resource scope across calls.
use_when: Agents access protected data or external systems
Actions must be attributed to both agent and invoking principal
avoid_when: The workload is anonymous and limited to public read-only data
Downstream services cannot enforce scoped identity
expected_effects: Reduced standing privilege and credential blast radius
Auditable delegation and revocation across agent hops
failure_modes: A broad service credential replaces user delegation
Tokens outlive approval or task state
Peer agents drop or forge delegation context
